# Issue #41: `slugify` produces double hyphens and trailing hyphens

`slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello--world-"` but should return `"hello-world"`.
Also `slugify("--a--b--")` should give `"a-b"`.

Please fix `textkit/slug.py`. Do not change the public signature.

# Treat each run of non-slug characters as one separator, then remove
    # separators introduced at either end of the input.
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text)
    return text.strip("-")

arguments.summary: Updated slugify to collapse consecutive non-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen and strip leading/trailing hyphens, fixing duplicate and trailing separators while preserving the public signature. All tests pass.
